extensions.source_label: DOE OSTI / DOE-EM contractor and site-mission task-order public dockets

extensions.claim_text: PESI completed fabrication, installation, commissioning, and startup of its first full-scale commercial Perma-FAS system for PFAS destruction at PFF (Gainesville, FL), has already processed commercial
extensions.source_label: USPTO Patent Application Full-Text and Image Database (AppFT) — pre-grant publication search
extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://appft.uspto.gov/netacgi/nph-Parser — assignee 'Perma-Fix' OR inventor 'Centofanti' with class focus on F23G / B01D / C02F (waste destruction)

extensions.source_label: EPA RCRA biennial report (RCRA-3) for PFF (FL Alachua County) and FL DEP hazardous-waste permit modifications
extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://rcrapublic.epa.gov/rcrainfoweb/ and FL DEP eRegulatory portal — permit modifications authorizing PFAS / AFFF treatment streams at PFF.
extensions.rationale: Adding a new commercial PFAS-destruction process at a RCRA Part B TSDF generally requires a permit modification approved by the state regulator and (sometimes) EPA. A real operational system has a paper trail.

extensions.claim_text: PESI incurred a net loss from continuing operations of approximately $19,569,000 in 2024 on revenue of $59,117,000 (down 34.1% YoY), recorded a full valuation allowance against deferred tax assets, an
extensions.source_label: PESI claim_evolution self-disclosure tracking on liquidity covenant and FCCR amendments
extensions.endpoint_or_method: claim_evolution.query_claim_evolution(cik='0000891532', search_term='FCCR', base_filing_date='2025-03-13', cutoff_date='2025-05-15') and similarly for 'going concern', 'covenant'
extensions.rationale: The 10-K narrates 3 successive PNC credit-facility amendments (May 2024, Nov 2024, Mar 2025) that progressively LOOSENED covenants — a textbook distress-cluster fingerprint per H10. Tracking subsequent 8-K cadence on covenant amendments is the most direct trajectory signal.
extensions.expected_observable: Subsequent 8-Ks on or before cutoff disclosing further covenant relief / waivers OR conversely, evidence that the company started meeting the FCCR on a trailing-twelve-month basis.
extensions.signal_direction: Further amendments / waivers = distress reaffirmed; clean covenant compliance = distress receding.

extensions.claim_text: PESI incurred a net loss from continuing operations of approximately $19,569,000 in 2024 on revenue of $59,117,000 (down 34.1% YoY), recorded a full valuation allowance against deferred tax assets, an
extensions.source_label: Going-concern fingerprint cluster check against H10
extensions.endpoint_or_method: Manual enumeration of cluster markers within ~6 months prior to cutoff: revenue down 34% YoY, two equity raises (May + Dec 2024), 3 successive credit-facility amendments (May 2024 / Nov 2024 / Mar 2025), full DTA valuation allowance, gross profit collapse to $2K (essentially zero), shareholder demand letter (Feb 2025), securities-class-action-style breach-of-fiduciary-duty complaint (Nov 2024 O'Neill).
extensions.rationale: H10 requires >=2-3 markers within 6 months; PESI shows 5+. However, none of the markers is the classic going-concern qualifier OR a reverse stock split, and the company has $28.975M cash on hand and zero revolver draw. The cluster is real but pattern is 'distress-funded-through-capital-markets' not 'distress-with-no-exit'.
extensions.expected_observable: Count of distress markers + auditor going-concern opinion / not.
extensions.signal_direction: Marker count + auditor opinion calibration. PESI auditor (Grant Thornton) did not issue a going-concern qualification per the 10-K text.

extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://www.energy.gov/nepa/ — Hanford LAW SEIS public-comment dockets and ROD (record of decision) timelines.
